name: lowcountry
note: The Lowcountry and Gulf pack on Meshy, the third of the US golf courses' landscapes (7 November 2026): Harbour Town, Sea Island, Kiawah. The owner has no photos here, so sizes, trunk widths and forms are PLACED from the reference photos: tall leaning live oaks with pale trunks, in a mix with loblolly pines. The loblolly is Southern Pines' own model. One picture per model, in the tufted language the owner chose for Classic Parkland. No hanging moss: the first pictures had it as thick solid curtains, because fine hanging detail does not survive the model step, and the owner turned it down. `seasons` are PLACED, read by tools/blender/dump-tints.mjs. Shipped in vendor/blender-meshy_lowcountry as LowLiveOak, LowCypress and LowSabal, because the hand-built models hold the plain names.
style: Stylised cartoon game art in soft, flat painted colour. Simple clean shapes with a gentle gradient: darker near the trunk and under each bough, lighter toward the tips. Matte, muted natural palette. No photographic detail, no photo bark, no noise, no speckle, no hard shadows, no highlights, no shine, no ink outlines, no text.
view: One view only, seen from the side at eye level, the whole plant in frame from foot to tip with a margin around it, centred, on a plain white background, in even soft light, with no cast shadow.

A slender trunk, one sixteenth of the tree's height wide near the ground, narrowing gently to two-thirds of that width where it divides, its sides never parallel. Only a small flare in the very bottom of the trunk, no wide base. Whole healthy tree, no broken or snapped top. Stylised cartoon game asset, matte hand-painted colour.
